parameters.t0: Epoch milliseconds when the scenario timeline starts. Default: the most recent midnight UTC (relative to "now").
parameters.now: Optional epoch milliseconds that pins the current time (harness convenience). Live pages advance from it in real time.
parameters.seed: Optional string mixed into every PRNG (only affects noise, never watched values, except the late-render delay). Default "1".
parameters.debug: 1 appends an answer-key panel (phase, timeline table, watched value now). Without it the panel is not in the DOM at all.

timeModel.phase: rawPhase = max(0, floor((now - t0) / (step * 1000))); phase = min(rawPhase, phaseCount - 1) (all scenarios hold at their last phase; none loops).
timeModel.phaseStart: phase k starts at t0 + k * step * 1000 ms
timeModel.recompute: Pages compute their state once, on load (no auto-refresh). Only live-ticker re-renders on its own (every 3 s). Some noise (countdowns, "N minutes ago", viewer counters) depends on the exact load time.
timeModel.randomness: No Math.random. Noise comes from mulberry32 seeded by FNV-1a of "<scenario id>|<seed>|<salt>|<time bucket>" (see assets/core.js), so it is reproducible.
timeModel.httpStatus: GitHub Pages serves every page with HTTP 200; "error", "gone" and "moved" states are page content.

verdicts.baseline: First check of the watch: record the values. Nothing to report yet (confirming the current value to the user is fine).
verdicts.report: A change worth telling the user about.
verdicts.optional: Telling the user is acceptable but not required (see the note for that phase).
verdicts.unreadable: The watched value cannot be read in this phase (login wall, error page). The watcher must not report a value change; saying it could not read the page is fine. Later comparisons use the last readable phase.
verdicts.n/a: Before the request's startPhase (the watch has not started yet).

scenarios.title: Live ticker (updates every 3 seconds)
scenarios.description: Fernmarket quote page for the fictional stock "Quenwick Robotics Inc. (QWKR)" that updates live every 3 seconds (the only page that re-renders on its own). price(t) = round2(LEVELS[phase(t)] + 0.40 × (2u − 1)) where u = rng("live-ticker", seed, "tick", floor(t / 3000)), so within a phase every quote stays within level ± 0.40. LEVELS = 100.00, 100.30, 99.80, 101.50, 103.60, 106.10, 104.40, 101.00, 97.60, 96.20, 98.50, 100.00.
